commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Cast seven-mana haste Zombie Assassin Thraximundar, make defending opponent sacrifice a creature on attack, grow him for every player's creature-sacrifice event and use Zombies, edicts and free altars to fuel death-drain or commander-damage wins.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized: engine-based sacrifice loops plus seven-mana commander-damage clock, without claims of independently verified Bracket 5 cEDH performance.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Do not replace the attack-when-attacks sacrifice, Zombie recursion, sacrifice-cost advantage and counter-growing commander with generic Oracle/Consultation or spell-combo shells.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: The M6 comprehensive per-source review accounts for all 93 rows and 99 library cards, while this ten-swap review reweighs slower five-to-seven-mana top end, repeated sacrifice payoffs, Grave Pact/Dictate, Gravecrawler and Skeleton loops, ramp and three slow dual lands. Core edict, Zombie and drain coverage remains.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: The exact 100 keeps 36 lands and Island x3/Mountain x2/Swamp x5; three conditional tap duals become Marsh Flats/Misty Rainforest/Verdant Catacombs. Fetches can search types, not arbitrary lands, and pay life; UBR color identity and official legality passed 93/93 live Scryfall names.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Keeps Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Deflecting Swat, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Flare of Malice and low-mana edicts. Regalia grants ward two/unblockable but loses Boots hexproof, and cheaper Priest/Ophiomancer/Plumb improve play under expensive Thrax tax.

weakest_slots.weakness: Five-mana end-step creature limiter is slower and less direct for cheap recurring Zombie casts.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Bontu's Monument brings Black creature discount and any creature cast drain turns Gravecrawler loops into opponent life-loss while easing Thrax-colored setup. The cost remains Loses flying board-pressure ceiling and independent opposing sacrifice each end step; requires creature casting.

weakest_slots.weakness: Two-mana boots with equip one give hexproof and haste, but Thraximundar already has native haste.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Brotherhood Regalia brings One-mana legendary equip grants unblockable and ward two to make seven-mana Thrax connect repeatedly. The cost remains Ward is weaker than hexproof against targeted removal if the attacker has available mana; no emergency haste for support bodies.

weakest_slots.weakness: Captain's three-color Zombie anthem/drain is good but three mana and restricted to Zombies dying.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Marionette Apprentice brings Apprentice makes a Servo or counter and drains when another owned creature or artifact dies, covering Treasure and Zombie loops. The cost remains Its own death does not trigger itself and it does not anthem Zombies; needs sacrifice/graveyard churn.

weakest_slots.weakness: Conditionally tapped dual can delay commander UBR when no Swamp/Mountain is controlled.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Marsh Flats brings Fetch basic Swamp or typed Underground Sea/Badlands into play, improving timely black/blue/red access. The cost remains Fetch costs one life and is susceptible to land-search denial; land availability must be legal.

weakest_slots.weakness: Conditional dual may enter tapped without prior Island/Swamp.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Misty Rainforest brings Fetch Island/Swamp typed duals or basic Island to increase untapped color access and shuffle. The cost remains Fetch requires valid land type target and one life, not infinite tri-color access.

weakest_slots.weakness: Five-mana self-growth Zombie untap-sac engine competes with costly commander deployment.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Ophiomancer brings Three-mana Snake token each upkeep when no Snake exists supplies ongoing zero-investment sacrifice fodder. The cost remains Snake is not a Zombie and only makes one at a time while another Snake remains; removal shuts off engine.

weakest_slots.weakness: Six-mana planeswalker provides broad grind value but starts late compared with fast sacrifice turns.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Plumb the Forbidden brings Two-mana instant sacrifices multiple bodies as optional cost to copy a draw spell, yielding source-paid cards and Thrax counters. The cost remains Consumes own fodder and life; copy counts require actual paid sacrifices; loses recurring planeswalker draw/wrath.

weakest_slots.weakness: Seven-mana mass-sacrifice sorcery is powerful but cannot repeatedly feed commander growth early.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Priest of Forgotten Gods brings Two-mana Priest trades two spare bodies for forced player sacrifices, BB and a card, feeding Thrax and drain engines. The cost remains Needs two other creatures, tap-ready Priest and legal targets; mass-wide answer is lost.

weakest_slots.weakness: Seven-mana Praetor supplies ongoing enemy edicts and own graveyard recursion, but competes with commander turn.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Roaming Throne brings Four-mana Throne named Zombie doubles other controlled Zombie triggers, including each Thrax sacrifice counter trigger. The cost remains Needs chosen Zombie type and Thrax to remain; does not itself recur dead creatures or force upkeep edicts.

weakest_slots.weakness: Conditionally tapped U/R dual may miss critical early black-pip access.
weakest_slots.reasoning: The approved challenger Verdant Catacombs brings Fetch Swamp or typed dual to correct black plus another needed color, and reduces tapland exposure. The cost remains Cannot fetch red alone without typed appropriate dual; one life and search denial apply.

weakest_slots.weakness: A three-mana instant edict is less permanent card advantage than a resilient death-drain enchantment.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: can force sacrifice at opponent priority before Thrax attacks, and City's Blessing potentially expands edict scope; already many drain payoffs.

weakest_slots.weakness: Enters tapped and is poor at immediate colored tempo compared with an additional fetchland.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: graveyard exile effect is unique land-slot interaction; Passage fetches tapped early and cannot replace that graveyard-hate insurance.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: The previous owner-approved October 15 100 was a coherent Bracket 4 KEEP under historical independent M6 Pass C, with 36 lands, fast Altars, Grave Pact/Dictate, Zombie support, sacrifice engines, recursion and strong black tutors. It was not a wrong or unapproved list.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Three extra outside-ranked alternatives Bastion, Woe Strider and Fabled Passage were challenged against actual current core roles and rejected on specific commander-first costs.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Rejected: persistent drain duplicates existing payoffs while sacrificing immediate edict/counter growth and unique one-land graveyard answer; Passage taps early.
Rejected: another free sacrifice outlet and passive drain replicate existing Altars/Bombardment/Blood Artist but lose flying/size damage clock and instant edict.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Retaining Vona's Hunger over Bastion, Cultist over Woe Strider and Bog over Fabled Passage prevents erosion of forced sacrifice, commander damage and independent graveyard hate.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The original M6 KEEP evaluated its approved 100 correctly; only a later owner-authorized larger change package can revise its unique role balance without treating historic proxy outcomes as causal proof.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Reweighted 99 library slots favour Bontu's Monument/Marionette for paid loop finish, Regalia for Thrax contact, Ophiomancer/Priest/Plumb for low-curve sacrifice, Throne for specific Zombie triggers and three legal typed fetches for better UBR deployment.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Exactly owner-exported commander-first raw 100, 93 distinct, 36 lands; basics Island3 Mountain2 Swamp5 only repeated, seven nonland cards and three fetches among ten 1:1 changes; no commander replacement.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After ten changes the remaining 99 slot checks challenged the retained edict core, protective Cultist, independent graveyard hate Bojuka Bog, numerous free sac outlets and the two recursion lines. The exact revised 100 preserves all original unique jobs while the three extra outside-ranked material candidates fail on commander-specific alternatives.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Bastion provides one more resilient death-drain enchantment and sacrificial body but loses instant forced opponent creature sacrifice that directly grows Thrax through the attack/edict plan.
An extra fetch improves color access but enters tapped for early basics, and removing the only Bog land loses important graveyard exile that can stop opposing recursion/combo.

open_ended_optimization_audit.no_credible_larger_package_reason: Two separate larger packages were tested as decision alternatives but rejected before changing another physical decklist. Bastion over Vona's Hunger duplicates four drain effects while losing forced sacrificial edict timing; Fabled Passage over Bojuka Bog changes unique graveyard denial into a tapped-basic fetch; Woe Strider over Cultist replaces high-value commander flying and growing attack pressure with another free outlet when four such outlets remain. Without better payable role evidence no seventh extra or twelfth swap is a genuine improvement.
open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Ten replacements were selected because each addresses a source-specific cost or synergy gap, not because ten was a quota. Current exact 100 preserves 36-land UBR access, all sacrifice/recursion combo pillars and independent graveyard/instant interaction. After revisiting Bastion, Woe Strider and Fabled Passage plus retained Vona's Hunger, Cultist and Bog, larger packages remove forced sacrifice, evasion/damage clock or graveyard answer for redundant drain/outlet/land fixing. No unexecuted multiplayer win rate is asserted.
